description: This file contains functions related to upgrading and firmware management for various target hardware platforms, including methods for upgrading SD card boot devices, copying configurations, and checking images. It is part of the system upgrade infrastructure tailored to different hardware variants.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade for SD card boot devices by writing kernel and root filesystem from tar archive to designated device partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade specifically for systems using UBI partitions, determining active slots and updating environment variables.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the SD boot device, maintaining user configurations across upgrades.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to the device based on its board type, for specific device variants.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates whether the current image is supported for upgrade on the device's hardware.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates the upgrade process depending on hardware type, calling specific upgrade functions.
